note: Proposal only. Merge these explicit amendments into the existing root docs/ui-refactor files; do not change original baseline hashes. Each reason documents an intentional user-requested discovery improvement.

lifecycleChanges.reason: Expose latest/recommendation failure and explicit retry state; keep service read order and add cancellation guards to every recommendation completion. The mount effect reruns only for the explicit loadAttempt retry action.

declarationAmendments.name: loadLatest
declarationAmendments.reason: Localize the recoverable latest-post failure message; the same paginated content read and cancellation guard remain.

declarationAmendments.name: loadFeatured
declarationAmendments.reason: Keep the existing analytics → curated → latest fallback order, guard all late updates after unmount, and distinguish failure of the final fallback from a real empty result.

declarationAmendments.name: handleSearchFocus
declarationAmendments.reason: Track a pending search load, mark it ready only after success, expose loading/error states and allow explicit retries after failure instead of permanently marking a failed load as loaded.

declarationAmendments.name: posts
declarationAmendments.reason: The temporary awaited posts variable is replaced by the fulfilled promise callback in handleSearchFocus; the same getPosts result is stored after success.

declarationAmendments.name: categories
declarationAmendments.reason: Only show real returned category counts; a successful empty response must not invent six categories with zero posts.

declarationAmendments.name: fallbackEntries
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove fabricated zero-count categories; HomeCategoryStrip already implements truthful loading/error/empty states.

declarationAmendments.name: sourceEntries
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove selection of fabricated fallback categories; real sorted API entries are mapped directly.

declarationAmendments.name: visibleSearchResults
declarationAmendments.reason: Sanitize and count every match before limiting the visible preview to nine cards; provide a link carrying the search query to the full listing.

declarationAmendments.name: pageParam
declarationAmendments.reason: Parse and validate the URL page as a positive safe integer, preventing NaN/partial integer values from becoming request page state.

declarationAmendments.name: initialCategory
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove duplicated initial category state; category is derived from URL on every navigation.

declarationAmendments.name: initialPage
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove duplicated initial page state; a validated currentPage is derived from URL on every navigation.

declarationAmendments.name: parsed
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove the superseded parseInt temporary; Number plus safe-integer validation now owns page normalization.

declarationAmendments.name: syncStateFromParams
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove the redundant URL-to-local-state synchronization callback; URL now owns category, tags, query, sorting and page together.

declarationAmendments.name: paramsCategory
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove the synchronization effect temporary because category is derived directly from URL.

declarationAmendments.name: paramsPageRaw
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove the synchronization effect temporary because page is derived directly from URL.

declarationAmendments.name: paramsPage
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove the synchronization effect temporary, including its NaN propagation path; page normalization occurs at the component boundary.

declarationAmendments.name: loadPage
declarationAmendments.reason: Keep the same getPostsPage read contract and cancellation guard; localize failure messaging, make retry retain current filters and wait until query debounce settles before requesting.

declarationAmendments.name: loadMeta
declarationAmendments.reason: Expose metadata loading/failure and retry states; remove the redundant page-size-one total read because its stored count was never rendered.

declarationAmendments.name: handleTagToggle
declarationAmendments.reason: Persist selected tags as repeated tag parameters and reset page to one, so home tag links and browser history actually apply filters.

declarationAmendments.name: handleClearTagFilters
declarationAmendments.reason: Remove only tag parameters and reset page; preserve query/category/sort.

declarationAmendments.name: clearFilters
declarationAmendments.reason: Clear the URL source of truth; redundant local setters are unnecessary and could race navigation.

declarationAmendments.name: handleCategoryChange
declarationAmendments.reason: Use the shared URL filter update to preserve other filters and reset pagination.

declarationAmendments.name: handlePageChange
declarationAmendments.reason: Update URL page directly and honor prefers-reduced-motion for scroll-to-top navigation.

declarationAmendments.name: featuredPost
declarationAmendments.reason: Show editorial lead only on the first, unfiltered latest-order page; filtered results use one uniform result list.

declarationAmendments.name: spotlightPosts
declarationAmendments.reason: Keep spotlight items exclusive to the unfiltered first latest-order page, preventing duplicated small result sets.

declarationAmendments.name: listPosts
declarationAmendments.reason: On editorial pages render only posts after lead/spotlights; for filtered or sorted pages render every result once.
